hypotheses.statement: Conventional event sourcing given the same information agrees with the ledger on all seven queries (the ledger is not shown to be non-redundant against it)
A Boolean state machine without history cannot answer the history query and loses concurrent proceedings
A fixed ACCESS_ONLY policy identifies fewer causes than the adaptive policy
On access, disagreement and cause, the equal-information causal model with the adaptive policy agrees with the ledger: no predictive advantage of the ledger

targets: receipts, evidence, proceedings, plans, measurements and closures of a synthetic ledger

instrument_conditions.information: the same events, the same scope, the same world
instrument_conditions.scenarios_per_world: about 12 (the sequence receipt, plan, execute, observe, revision)

primary: agreement with the ledger on seven queries

reproduction.world: xzr.teoo.lawledger (SQLite, append-only) on xzr.teoo.lawworld (8 Booleans); this implementation's own world, not Appendix O

L701.criterion: event sourcing with the same information agrees with the ledger on every query in every scenario (so the ledger shows no non-redundancy against it)

L702.criterion: A cannot answer the history query in any scenario and disagrees with the ledger on open proceedings in some

L703.contrast: causes identified per world: adaptive minus fixed policy

L704.criterion: agreement on access, disagreement and cause in every scenario
L704.reading: met: no predictive advantage of the ledger or its vocabulary; what the ledger adds is the audit trail (validity, history, proceedings, closure), and an event-sourced store with the same fields has it too

catalogue.source: The Minimum Guarantees of Human Legal Subjecthood, Publication Final V3.0, Chapter 6.2 (identical in the 100_POINT_EDITION and in R2 section 4: all fifteen titles and definitions compared character for character)
catalogue.note: V3.0 uses two vocabularies for the same five findings (Appendix A table: Secured/Partial/Absent/Indeterminate/Inapplicable; A.3 and 8.4 text: Satisfied/Partially Satisfied/Failed/Indeterminate/Not Applicable). R2 section 16 and this implementation use the table's.

note: results about a SYNTHETIC ledger and this implementation's own world; the manuscripts R5-R16, the historical code and the world of Appendix O were not available and their numbers are not reproduced; a closure, a measurement or a match here is not a legal judgment or a restoration; not an observation of any institution, law or person
